description.ar: كرسي مفرد مريح مصمم بأذرع عريضة مع حواف أنيقة (Piping)، وظهر منجد بغرزة وسطية غائرة، مستنداً على هيكل معدني زاوي بلون داكن يعكس الفخامة المعاصرة.
description.fr: Fauteuil ergonomique aux accoudoirs évasés avec passepoil raffiné, dossier capitonné au centre et piétement métallique angulaire sombre.
description.en: Comfortable lounge armchair featuring wide flared arms with delicate piping, center-tufted backrest, and dark angular metal side legs.

description.ar: كنبة صالون فاخرة متطابقة مع كرسي الجلد، مزودة بوسادتين مربعتين بنقش هندسي دقيق، تمنح غرفة المعيشة هيبة ورونقاً ملكياً.
description.fr: Canapé de salon haut de gamme assorti au fauteuil, accompagné de deux coussins carrés aux motifs géométriques délicats.
description.en: Luxury living sofa matching the leather armchair design, complete with two square geometric pattern cushions on dark metal architectural legs.

description.fr: Chef-d’œuvre sculptural mariant la douceur texturée du bouclé ivoire à un socle en bois massif, avec 3 coussins assortis.
description.en: Sculptural curved sofa combining cozy ivory bouclé texture with a handcrafted warm wooden base plinth and three tailored lumbar cushions.

description.fr: Fauteuil unique au style affirmé, remarquable par son liseré vertical noir en façade des accoudoirs, son coussin dédié et ses pieds chromés argentés.
description.en: Contemporary single accent chair featuring distinct black vertical accent strips on the arm fronts, matching back cushion, and polished chrome-silver legs.

description.en: Grand oval dining table in high-gloss warm polished hardwood atop a solid cylindrical pedestal, complete with 6 curved-back upholstered chairs and a gold candelabra centerpiece.

description.en: Classic-modern rectangular coffee table crafted with a perimeter inlaid groove on top and an open lower tier for elegant display.

description.en: Royal accent side table featuring a polished round top, graceful tripod arched legs joined by a lower triangular tier, and ornate gold relief medallions on the rim.

description.en: Dual palatial drapery system composed of heavy geometric textured taupe curtains paired with a delicate white sheer layer and lustrous pearl tiebacks.
